description: Korean statutory inheritance shares (민법 제1009조: spouse 1.5 vs 1 per child or parent) and forced-heirship reserve shortfall (유류분, 민법 제1112조 as amended 2026-03-17: children and spouse 1/2, parents 1/3, siblings removed). Reserve basis = estate + lifetime gifts to heirs + gifts to others within 1 year − debts. Gifts and bequests are keyed by heir id (spouse, child1, child2, parent1 …). Returns each heir's share, reserve, what they received and the shortfall, plus the 1-year / 10-year claim limits. Excludes representation, renunciation and contribution shares.

bequests.description: Bequests to heirs keyed by heir id

children.description: Number of children (or their descendants as one line each)

estate.description: Positive estate at death including bequeathed property (KRW)

gifts.description: Lifetime gifts to heirs keyed by heir id, e.g. {"child1": 300000000}

siblings.description: Number of siblings (heirs only when no spouse, child or parent)

thirdGifts.description: Gifts to non-heirs within 1 year before death

name: calculate_kr_inheritance_reserve
title: calculate kr inheritance reserve
